extensions.name: FastStream
extensions.subtitle: 网页视频播放器
extensions.description: 将网页中的视频替换为 FastStream 播放器，使用熟悉的进度、画质和字幕控制。
extensions.description_en: Replace a webpage video with FastStream, with playback, quality, and subtitle controls.
extensions.note: DRM 保护内容及部分网站的视频可能无法播放。
extensions.note_en: DRM-protected videos and some websites may not play.

extensions.name: 猫抓
extensions.subtitle: 网页媒体资源助手
extensions.description: 查看当前网页发现的媒体资源，复制链接或下载，也可使用在线合并与缓存捕获。
extensions.description_en: Find media resources on the current page, copy links, or download them. Includes merge and cache-capture tools.
extensions.note: 可用资源取决于网站；分离的音视频可能需要合并。
extensions.note_en: Available resources depend on the site; separate audio and video may need merging.

extensions.name: 篡改猴
extensions.subtitle: 用户脚本管理
extensions.description: 安装、编辑和管理用户脚本，在授权的网站上运行。
extensions.description_en: Install, edit, and manage userscripts and run them on sites you allow.
extensions.note: 脚本的可用功能取决于站点权限和所用接口。仍有部分 Chrome 专用接口受 iOS 限制。
extensions.note_en: Script functionality depends on site access and the APIs used. Some Chrome-specific APIs remain limited on iOS.

extensions.name: Imageye 批量图片下载器
extensions.subtitle: 网页图片查找与保存
extensions.description: 从工具栏打开 Imageye，查看当前网页找到的图片并选择保存。
extensions.description_en: Open Imageye from the toolbar to view images found on the current page and choose which to save.
tested: 工具栏弹窗与图片识别
extensions.note: 可识别的图片和批量保存效果取决于网页。
extensions.note_en: Image detection and bulk saving depend on the webpage.

extensions.name: Soulo 搜索平台助手
extensions.subtitle: 从网页添加搜索平台
extensions.subtitle_en: Add a search platform from a webpage
extensions.description: 在网站搜索框输入 %s 并提交。结果地址出现搜索词后，点击提示里的「添加平台」，确认名称和分组后保存。
extensions.description_en: Search for %s on a website. When the result URL includes the search term, tap Add platform, review its name and group, then save.
tested: 网址中的查询参数和路径
extensions.note: 适用于同源且在结果网址中保留搜索词的网站。
extensions.note_en: Works with same-origin searches whose result URL includes the search term.

extensions.name: GoFullPage
extensions.subtitle: 网页整页截图
extensions.description: 从网页工具栏启动整页截图，在结果页预览并导出图片或 PDF。
extensions.description_en: Capture the full webpage from the toolbar, then preview and export it as an image or PDF.
tested_en: Preview with PNG and PDF export
extensions.note: PNG 和 PDF 导出已在 iPadOS 26.6.1 真机及 iOS 18.6 模拟器通过。预览无需下载权限，导出时按提示授权。高级编辑需要 GoFullPage Premium。
extensions.note_en: PNG and PDF export were verified on iPadOS 26.6.1 hardware and an iOS 18.6 simulator. Preview works without download permission. Grant permission when exporting. Advanced editing requires GoFullPage Premium.

extensions.name: Video Speed Controller
extensions.subtitle: 网页视频倍速
extensions.description: 通过扩展弹窗选择预设倍速，或逐步调整网页视频的播放速度。
extensions.description_en: Use the extension popup to choose a preset speed or adjust web video playback in small steps.
tested: 逐档加速、减速与恢复 1 倍
tested_en: Playback speed presets in the popup
Speed up, slow down, and reset to 1×
extensions.note: 倍速操作在 iOS 18.6 模拟器的 HTML5 视频中实测。不同网站的播放器支持情况可能不同。
extensions.note_en: Speed controls were tested with HTML5 video in the iOS 18.6 simulator. Site player compatibility can vary.

extensions.name: Selection Colors
extensions.subtitle: 网页文字选中色
extensions.description: 调整选中文字的前景色、背景色和透明度，并在弹窗中预览。
extensions.description_en: Adjust the text color, background color, and opacity of selected text and preview the result in the popup.
tested: 文字和背景颜色、透明度及预览
保存配置并在网页刷新后生效
tested_en: Text and background colors, opacity, and preview
Saved settings applied after page reload
extensions.note: 修改后刷新网页。已验证本地保存和应用效果，跨设备同步待验证。
extensions.note_en: Reload the page after making changes. Local settings and their effect on pages were tested. Cross-device sync remains unverified.

extensions.name: Dark Reader
extensions.subtitle: 网页深色模式
extensions.description: 为网页应用深色主题，可以从工具栏弹窗按网站开启或关闭。
extensions.description_en: Apply a dark theme to webpages and control it per site from the toolbar popup.
tested: 网页实际应用深色样式
从弹窗关闭当前网站的深色主题
tested_en: Dark styles applied to a webpage
Turn off the theme for the current site from the popup
extensions.note: 在 iOS 18.6 模拟器实测了网页深色和站点开关。显示效果会随网站样式而变化。
extensions.note_en: Page darkening and the per-site switch were tested in the iOS 18.6 simulator. Results can vary with the website's styling.
